nodes.title: 短片条件编码｜人物图 + 原视频 + SAM3运动（≤15秒）

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman defined by <Picture 1>: black hair tied in a neat top bun with wispy face-framing strands and soft see-through bangs, a round youthful face with natural light makeup, almond eyes, fair skin tone, a slender-to-average build, a delicate thin-chain necklace with a tiny pendant, a white spaghetti-strap long dress with a lace-trimmed V-neck, vertical pleated texture, and a sheer lace-hemmed floor-length skirt, plus beige thin-strap slide sandals. Preserve her exact facial proportions, face shape, five-sense features, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle, dress cut, lace details, necklace, and sandals throughout. The plain white photo-studio background of <Picture 1> is not part of <Subject 1>.
<Subject 2> is the indoor room environment from <Video 1>: a floor-to-ceiling gray vertical-striped curtain backdrop, a white ceiling with two recessed round spotlights, a light-gray smooth floor, a pink yoga mat printed with faint exercise guide graphics, and a white-and-green alpaca plush doll against the right side of the curtain.
<Subject 3> is the complete body motion and dance rhythm of the dancer in <Video 2>. Only the movement is referenced; the black background and the original dancer's clothing are discarded.
<Video 1> is the source video. It defines the vertical 9:16 duration, fixed single-camera framing, camera height, subject placement, room lighting, scene continuity, and pacing.
<Video 2> is the movement source only.
<Audio 1> is the complete original soundtrack of <Video 1>, reused 1:1 without changing timing or mix.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The original dancer is completely removed and replaced by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> copies the entire movement of <Subject 3>. The room environment, framing, camera behavior, lighting, and pacing stay consistent with <Video 1>. All Douyin watermarks, account numbers, and search labels are removed. Duration follows <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her hairstyle, face, five-sense features, skin tone, body proportions, necklace, white dress, and sandals from <Picture 1> remain visually stable; her white studio background is excluded.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the curtains, ceiling spotlights, floor, yoga mat, and alpaca doll from <Video 1> keep their positions and lighting.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the full movement and rhythm from <Video 2> are transferred frame-for-frame onto <Subject 1>, adapted only to her longer dress and sandals.
<Video 1> (full duration, framing, camera, lighting, temporal structure): partially_preserved - the room, fixed camera angle, subject scale, lighting, and pacing are retained, while the original dancer and all watermarks are removed.
<Video 2> (movement and rhythm): weak_reference - only the dance motion is referenced; its black background and clothing are discarded.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - the complete synchronized soundtrack from <Video 1> is reused 1:1.

detailed_description:
The target video combines <Subject 1>'s appearance from <Picture 1> with the realistic indoor room environment and original shot structure of <Video 1>. The final duration exactly matches <Video 1>. The result is one continuous static full shot with no cuts and no camera movement.
[Shot 1] The shot opens with the identical composition, camera height, focal length, and room environment established by <Video 1>. <Subject 2> stays fixed. The original woman in the mint polo shirt and white cargo pants is absent from every frame.
FRAME LOCK: The white ceiling with its two recessed round spotlights occupies the top roughly one quarter of the frame. The gray vertical-striped curtains start below the ceiling and extend down to the floor. The pink yoga mat fills the bottom roughly one third of the frame, extending well beyond the character's feet. The character stands centered horizontally; the top of her bun sits clearly below the ceiling line, leaving visible white ceiling above her head — she does NOT fill the frame vertically. Her feet rest on the pink mat roughly at the lower one-third mark. The white-and-green alpaca plush doll stands fully visible on the right side of the frame, not cropped. The framing is 100% inherited from <Video 1>; do not adopt the tight full-body framing of <Picture 1>.
<Subject 1> occupies the original dancer's on-screen position and scale. She wears the white lace-trimmed spaghetti-strap long dress, the thin-chain necklace, and the beige slide sandals from <Picture 1>, and no other clothing.
<Subject 1> reproduces <Subject 3> frame-for-frame, copying every movement, gesture, step, rhythm, and facial expression from <Video 2> exactly, with nothing added, removed, or re-interpreted. The white dress sways naturally with the dance as a single coherent layer of cloth — no double exposure, no ghosting, no semi-transparent overlapping layers, no fabric artifacts.
The two recessed ceiling spotlights fall naturally across her: soft overhead highlights on the bun, shoulders, and upper dress; gentle ambient fill from the gray curtains; soft shadow under her chin and along her body; a physically consistent contact shadow beneath her sandals on the pink mat.
CRITICAL LIGHTING LOCK: Exposure, brightness, white balance, and contrast remain perfectly constant across every frame, identical to the first frame. No flickering, no pumping brightness, no sudden darkening, no spotlight, no follow-spot, no rim light, no white halo around the character, no vignetting, no god rays. The white dress, arms, legs, feet, and sandals remain fully visible and correctly exposed in every frame; the lower skirt and feet never dissolve into darkness.
IDENTITY LOCK: Her face, features, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle, necklace, and dress design remain stable from first frame to last; no face-swap artifacts, no clothing morphing, no body distortion, no extra limbs, no duplicated hands, no drifting identity.
PROHIBITED: no mint polo shirt, no white cargo pants, no white socks; no white photo-studio background, no softbox front lighting; no pure black background; no Douyin logo, no account number, no search bar, no subtitles, no watermark, no interface graphics, no readable overlay text.

overall_soundscape:
<Audio 1> is fully copied as the target video's synchronized soundtrack, preserving the original music, room ambience, and timing of <Video 1> without alteration. No additional sound effects are added.

non_diegetic_music:
All music contained in <Audio 1> is reused unchanged. No new music is added.
